exceptions.title: does not dismiss when pressing portalled content inside the popup but outside the list
exceptions.reason: React sends the press of a portal up the React tree, so the popup knows that the press is inside it. A Vue press goes up the DOM only, and a `Teleport` puts its content outside the popup. The press is thus a press outside the popup, and it closes the popup.

exceptions.title: does not navigate the list with arrow keys from portalled controls inside the popup
exceptions.reason: React sends the key of a portal up the React tree, so the list could get it. A Vue key goes up the DOM only, and a `Teleport` puts its content outside the list. The list thus gets no such key.

exceptions.reason: The case gives `aria-hidden` the value `undefined` and asserts that the part removes the attribute. Vase UI keeps the value of the part for `undefined` and removes it for `null` (VUE-103). The case "VUE-103: aria-hidden of the consumer is $name" tests both values.
